verdict.rationale: Whether a cloud deployment platform's source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says Railway's source is available or names any open license. The docs cover the CLI, the MCP server, agent skills and llms.txt, none of which establish open-source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
